writeup: TIC 46208125 is a candidate eclipsing binary star with an orbital period of 5.1879 days. Analysis of TESS photometry reveals a primary eclipse causing 4.09% dimming and a secondary eclipse detected at 6.4 sigma significance. The binary lens effect shows a strong signal-to-noise ratio of 165.5 using the Box Least Squares method. Pixel-level difference imaging confirms the signal's authenticity with a peak signal-to-noise of 23.7, though the centroid offset measures 3.4 arcsec from the target star. This candidate does not appear in six major variable-star catalogs, making it a novel find. The automated pipeline's machine learning model assigned it a screening score of 0.40, and the candidate passed all data quality checks without any flagged concerns.
